name: nodejs.update
description: Update /opt/node/NN to the newest release of its major from nodejs.org, verified as nodejs.install does (signed SHASUMS256.txt, SHA-256, safe unpack). It does nothing when the install is already at the newest release. Otherwise it moves the current tree to /opt/node/.NN.previous (replacing an older one), renames the new one into place, restarts the running supervisor programs and systemd units whose command runs /opt/node/NN/bin/node (or whose PATH names its bin directory), waits 10 s and checks each is RUNNING or active with no restart since. If one isn't, it swaps the old tree back, restarts them again and fails. It refuses if /opt/node/NN isn't installed or the release doesn't verify.

major.description: The installed Node.js major, two digits, such as 22.

health_check: The helper restarts what runs the install and swaps the old tree back unless each program is RUNNING and each unit active, without restarting, 10 s later.
